jobs.title: Senior / Lead AI Engineer
jobs.jd: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior / Lead AI Engineer Senior / Lead AI Engineer - Foundry R&D, Singapore We are looking for a Senior / Lead AI Engineer to be part of The Mastercard Foundry R&D team. You will be part of the team that drives Mastercard's innovation journey by consistently looking to discover and learn new skills and technologies and apply them to create highly scalable products. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, willing to experiment, agile, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. What you'll do * Drive Generative AI Innovation: Lead the design and development of advanced AI solutions and proof-of-concepts focused on generative AI (e.g. LLMs, GANs). You will create prototypes, pilots, and MVPs that explore new use cases and demonstrate the art of the possible in payments and commerce. This includes pushing the frontier of applied AI through rapid experimentation and applied research. * Technical Leadership: Provide hands-on technical leadership to a small, agile team of engineers. Guide the full software development lifecycle - from translating requirements into technical designs to coding, testing, and deployment. You'll establish high engineering standards (clean code, CI/CD, robust testing) and ensure production-ready quality for AI services. Mentor junior engineers and foster an innovation mindset within the team. * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams - including product owners, data scientists, researchers, and platform engineers - to identify AI opportunities and deliver solutions that meet business needs. You'll liaise with global teams in a fast-moving environment, ensuring alignment on project objectives and integrating generative AI features into existing products and processes. * Model Deployment and Integration: You will oversee deploying these AI models into production environments and integrating them seamlessly with applications (in partnership with software and data engineers). * R&D and Continuous Learning: Stay abreast of the latest developments in AI and especially generative AI. As part of Foundry R&D, you are expected to continuously explore emerging technologies (e.g. new model architectures, multimodal AI, agent-driven automation) and assess their potential impact on our products. You'll drive a culture of innovation by experimenting with advanced techniques (like retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge-grounded LLMs) and championing their adoption where they add value. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: IRIS Data Scientist / AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About the role: As a Data Scientist, you will contribute to the industrialization and European rollout of IRIS, an AIbased platform designed to extract and understand information from business documents. You will be responsible for onboarding new document types and data points, improving extraction quality and supporting the reliable operation of AI analytical components. The role combines data analysis, model development, evaluation, prompt optimization and collaboration with business and technical stakeholders across countries. Key focus areas: Onboarding of new document types and new data points. Data extraction solutions and confidence-score mechanisms. Prompt tuning, model optimization and continuous improvement. Quality monitoring, performance evaluation and production maintenance. Country integration support and progressive industrialization of the AI-based platform. Main responsibilities: Analyze and explore labelled and production data to understand document structures, data quality and extraction behaviour. Perform first-level quality assurance of labelled datasets; identify inconsistencies and coordinate corrections with business stakeholders. Prepare, train, evaluate and improve extraction solutions for new document types and new data points. Build and enhance data-extraction components, including confidence-score calculation and validation. Investigate failed or low-confidence values, identify root causes and update rules, prompts or datasets as appropriate. Calculate and interpret quality metrics for each data point and document type; communicate findings and recommended improvements. Tune and optimize prompts used in OCR, document understanding or GenAI-supported processing. Produce and optimize Python-based analytical models and tools, with attention to scalability, resource usage and maintainability. Ensure that code, datasets, assumptions, evaluation results and operational procedures are clearly documented and production-ready. Support recurring production runs and contribute to automation, monitoring and incident investigation together with the Support Engineer and partner teams. Contribute to country integrations and the onboarding of additional document types, while reusing common components whenever possible. Ensure model outputs are interpretable; identify potential bias, quality limitations and performance gaps in relation to business needs. Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, peer reviews and knowledge sharing activities Ways of working Work within one shared product backlog, one sprint goal and shared ownership across the IRIS Product Squad. Collaborate closely with the CoE AI Core Team, country stakeholders and relevant IT teams, with clear escalation to Level 3 expertise when required. Maintain clear documentation, transparent status reporting and a strong focus on service quality, delivery and continuous improvement What we are looking for: Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, data analytics or intelligent document processing. Hands-on experience developing, evaluating and maintaining data-driven solutions in a production-oriented environment. Experience collaborating with business users, developers, support teams and distributed international stakeholders. Fluency in English; another European language is an advantage. Technical and professional skills Strong Python programming and scripting skills. Sound knowledge of machine learning, statistical analysis, quantitative evaluation and experiment design. Experience with data preparation, labelling quality checks, model evaluation metrics and error analysis. Knowledge of OCR, document AI, information extraction, prompt engineering or GenAI-based processing is a strong advantage. Knowledge of Git, CI/CD practices, Jira or equivalent Agile tools. Experience with SQL, relational databases, ETL processes and BI or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is desirable. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, collaboration, adaptability, initiative and delivery focus Collaboration Type: B2B Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Finance Data Scientist
jobs.jd: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Finance Data Scientist to join our central Data team as the first dedicated analytics partner to Finance. You'll turn billing, revenue and forecasting data into audit-ready numbers, and the analysis that shapes pricing and planning decisions as we scale towards IPO. Own finance-facing analysis: revenue and ARR reconciliation, cohort and retention economics, pricing and packaging experiments. Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified finance KPI layer (ARR, billing, revenue), and be the first to catch when a number is quietly wrong. Build forecasting and scenario models that FP&A uses directly in planning and board reporting. Translate ambiguous finance questions from FP&A, RevOps and leadership into clear, reusable analysis. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist or analyst embedded with a Finance / FP&A function, ideally at a growth-stage or pre-IPO company. Strong SQL and Python , with comfort reconciling data across Stripe, Salesforce and a dbt-modelled warehouse. Finance fluency : ARR, billing, revenue recognition, cohort economics — you can speak FP&A's language. Rigour around data quality : you reconcile by default and can explain a variance, not just report it. Strong stakeholder management with Finance leadership, and the ability to push back on ambiguous asks. Bonus Experience preparing finance data for audit, SOX or IPO readiness. Experience with pricing / packaging experimentation or revenue forecasting at a subscription or usage-based business. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse (BigQuery), partnering directly with analytics engineers. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Lead Finance Data Scientist role as the central Data team scales. Expand scope into broader strategic finance or RevOps analytics. Path into a Head of FP&A Analytics or data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. jobs.title: Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics
jobs.jd: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure. As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services. We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances. Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Why loveholidays? We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams. The difference you’ll make You’ll sit in the Data Science team, reporting to the Head of Data Science. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering teams to develop predictive models for pricing, recommendations, and other business domains. Together, the team will leverage data to build statistical models that improve commercial decisions. Data Science sits within our Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers. Your day-to-day: Build and improve data science products across pricing, recommendations and other business domains to improve customer experiences and commercial outcomes. Turn ambiguous business problems into practical data science solutions, from exploration and modelling through to experimentation and evaluation. Partner with engineers, analysts and product teams to deploy reliable models and embed recommendations into everyday decision-making. Monitor model performance, investigate changes and continuously improve solutions as customer behaviour and business needs evolve. Communicate findings clearly, challenge assumptions and help teams make confident, evidence-based decisions. Your skillset: Strong experience developing and delivering practical machine learning solutions, balancing model performance, business value and long-term maintainability. Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working with large, complex datasets. A solid grounding in statistics, experimentation and machine learning, including model evaluation and causal thinking. Experience collaborating with engineers to deploy, monitor and improve models in production. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence product and commercial decisions. The interview journey: Intro with a member of our Talent Acquisition team - 30 minutes 1st Stage: Virtual Interview with Hiring Manager - 45 minutes 2nd Stage: Two on-site interviews 50 minutes for a project discussion deepdive with member(s) of the Data Science team 1 hour technical discussion around a case study with member(s) of the Data Science team Final-stage: Virtual interview with key stakeholders - 45 minutes Perks of joining us: Company pension contributions at 5% Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum Ability to buy and sell annual leave Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers Our commitment to inclusion At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy. Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here ! The Senior Machine Learning Engineer will join our ML team. This team is responsible for building, maintaining, and monitoring the production ML models and offline experimentation frameworks that are at the core of Signifyd’s product. This includes the core fraud detection model that decides the majority of our traffic, alongside our model training and evaluation infrastructure. We work closely with Platform Engineering teams to contribute novel modeling methods, advanced feature engineering, and robust statistical practices. Our Culture We value tenacity, curiosity, and a hunger for learning. Our adversaries are highly motivated fraudsters looking to exploit any gap. We seek equally motivated individuals who are passionate about keeping our customers safe while pulling the field of adversarial machine learning forward. The Role As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer , you will be a driver of technical execution within the ML team. You won’t just build models—you’ll own the end-to-end lifecycle of high-impact ML projects, from offline experimentation to deployment to production. You will be responsible for improving model performance, refining our experimentation processes, and ensuring our fraud detection systems are robust, scalable, and scientifically sound. Responsibilities: Expand ML Capabilities – Identify, prototype, and integrate new ML technologies and infrastructure to enhance fraud detection effectiveness and scalability. Enable High-Velocity Experimentation – Own the design and implementation of ML pipeline components that accelerate our innovation Collaborate Across Functions – Partner with Product, Engineering, and Risk teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure ML initiatives align with customer needs. Raise the Bar – Foster a culture of technical excellence by championing best practices in testing, documentation, model monitoring, and development. Requirements: Education: A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a comparable quantitative field. Experience: 4-6+ years of post-undergrad work experience in a production-grade ML environment. Technical Depth: Strong foundation in machine learning theory, statistical evaluation, and experience with supervised/unsupervised learning at scale. Execution Focus: Proven track record of taking ML projects from research/prototype to high-scale production environments. Communication: Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders. Tech Stack: Proficiency in Python , SQL, key ML libraries, and Spark Mindset: A strong outcome-oriented mindset—you care about the "why" behind the models and the business impact they create. Attention to detail is critical in fraud prevention. Make an Impact – Your work will directly shape the future of fraud prevention, protecting billions of payments. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead
jobs.jd: Be yourself at Protolabs Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. Why Protolabs? We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. Join our team as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead! This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain. The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority. What You Will Do: Technical leadership & core development Drive core development of transformative capabilities. Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives. Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management. Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases. Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner. Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups. Market observation & innovation Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company. Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability. Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers. Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements. Cross-organisation delivery & architecture Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions. Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review. Platform & environment Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment. Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability. Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery. Mentoring & influencing Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews. Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them. Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization. What You Bring: Technical 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data. Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers). Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes. Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt). Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vect

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.jd: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Bei uns erwartet dich ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe - ohne Hierarchien. Für unseren Bereich Forward Deployed Engineering suchen wir dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht empfiehlt, sondern baut, deployt und in Produktion verantwortet. Was dich erwartet Forward Deployed heißt bei uns: Du bist Beobachter, Architekt und Entwickler in einer Person. Dieselbe Person, die das Problem beim Kunden versteht, schreibt den Code, der es löst - und bleibt, bis es produktiv läuft. End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Deployments von der Discovery über technisches Scoping, Architektur und Build bis zum Produktions-Rollout in der Infrastruktur des Kunden - eingebettet in dessen Engineering- und Fachteams. Full-Stack, wörtlich gemeint: Du arbeitest über alle Schichten - Model-Serving (vLLM, eigene GPU-Cluster), Agent-Gateways und Runtimes, RAG-/GraphRAG-Pipelines, spezialisierte Agenten, Integration in ERP, CRM, DMS und Legacy-Systeme. Auf erprobtem Fundament: Du deployst und erweiterst unsere Produkt-Stacks (mAIstack, VoiceAI, Amicable) beim Kunden, statt jedes Projekt bei null zu beginnen – mit LLMs wie GPT, Gemini, Claude oder Nemotron, Agent-Frameworks und agentischen Harnesses. Vector-Datenbanken und RAG sind dabei Handwerkszeug; als Senior sorgst du dafür, dass die Systeme im Betrieb messbar und beherrschbar bleiben – über Dataset-basierte Evaluations, Logging/Tracing und Observability. Der Rückfluss ist Teil des Jobs: Was sich im Feld als wiederkehrendes Muster erweist, kodifizierst du mit deinem Team in unseren Produkten, Skills und Playbooks. Dein Projektwissen bleibt nicht beim Kunden liegen - es macht das nächste Deployment schneller. Kunde auf Augenhöhe: Du entwickelst in Workshops ein gemeinsames Bild von Problem, Chancen und Lösung, triffst Trade-off-Entscheidungen zwischen Scope, Tempo und Qualität - und sprichst auch an, was der Kunde nicht hören will, wenn es das Ergebnis schützt. Sichtbarkeit: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen in Whitepaper, Talks und unsere AI-Produkte ein - mit Unterstützung unserer technischen Redaktion. Das solltest du mitbringen Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung. Du hast LLM-Systeme in Produktion gebracht - nicht nur prototypisiert: RAG-Implementierungen, Vector Databases, Agent-Frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK o. ä.), Evals und MLOps. Erfahrung mit der Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende, gewachsene Enterprise-Architekturen - inklusive der unbequemen Teile (Auth, Legacy, Compliance). Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Inference-Infrastruktur (vLLM, GPU-Serving), Kubernetes und On-Prem-/Private-Cloud-Deployments. Die Kompetenz, AI-Konzepte Fachbereichen und C-Level anschaulich zu vermitteln - und die Standfestigkeit, Ownership für Entscheidungen zu übernehmen. Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau. Bereitschaft, phasenweise beim Kunden vor Ort zu arbeiten (projektabhängig, remote-embedded als Regelfall), plus Workshops und Konferenzen 1–2× im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung und Kompetenz vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 80.000 € bis 90.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden. Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung. Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt. Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten. Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche. Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden. Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich. Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit. Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth. Job Title: Machine Learning Engineer Location: Remote Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099] Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually Experience Required: 8+ years Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position. Job Summary Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to develop, train, evaluate, and operationalize predictive and classification models for production applications. The engineer will work across data preparation, feature engineering, model experimentation, validation, and deployment, partnering with data scientists and software teams to deliver measurable model performance and maintainable services. Key Responsibilities Prepare datasets, engineer features, and build reproducible training and validation pipelines. Develop, tune, and evaluate machine learning models for classification, regression, ranking, or forecasting use cases. Implement model-serving components and integrate inference workflows with application and data platforms. Track model performance, investigate drift or quality degradation, and recommend retraining or improvement actions. Document experiments, model assumptions, evaluation results, and implementation decisions for engineering stakeholders. Required Qualifications Experience Required: typically 8+ years in machine learning engineering, applied data science, or related production model development; align with the approved requisition. Strong Python skills and practical experience with libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, or equivalent tools. Understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, and statistical fundamentals. Experience with at least one deep-learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, where relevant to the project. Strong analytical reasoning, experimentation discipline, and communication of model trade-offs. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack & AI Engineer
jobs.jd: Description MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment. Why does MWDN rock? Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN : Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises. Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals. Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes. Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events. Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU. What is your new project? Domain: Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals Client Location: Israel Company size: 10-50 Founded in: 2016 What makes this project exciting? We’re looking for a senior engineer who can build AI native products on top of reliable, secure, high quality data systems. Someone who has experience shipping production level software for high trust workflows, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, can deploy safe agentic systems, and knows how to design robust architecture that scales. This role is for someone who has shipped production software at scale, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, and knows how to deploy AI systems that are useful, observable, and safe. You’ll work across the full stack: data ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, product surfaces, AI workflows, agentic systems, and observability. What makes you a great fit You have strong production engineering judgment and can move quickly without compromising reliability, data integrity, and security: ● 8+ years building production software ● Strong experience with TypeScript, React, SQL ● Deep backend architecture, API, data modeling, and production debugging skills ● Significant experience with data pipelines, integrations, or data-heavy systems ● Experience building systems that handle sensitive, regulated, and high trust data ● Production experience shipping robust AI/LLM-powered features ● Strong understanding of evals, hallucinations, malformed outputs, retrieval quality, latency, cost, model drift, and provider risk ● Good judgment about when to use an LLM, when to use retrieval, when to improve the data foundation, and when deterministic code is the better answer ● Excellent written and verbal communication in English ● High ownership AI safety and security: ● You know how to build AI systems that are useful without being reckless. ● You understand prompt injection, permission boundaries, data exfiltration risk, secrets handling, audit logs, and human in the loop review. You treat model context as untrusted input and design agent systems with scoped tools, explicit permissions, logging, evals, and graceful failure modes. ● Security is non-negotiable. You should be comfortable with access control, Postgres RLS, PII handling, secrets management, audit trails, least privilege, secure integrations, and safe use of third-party APIs. You’ll be especially strong if: ● You have built sturdy data pipelines customer facing products rely on ● You care about data correctness before AI or dashboards depend on it ● You can trace a bad number across ingestion, transformation, database, API, UI, and AI context ● You think naturally in failure modes: stale data, duplicate events, schema drift, partial writes, bad joins, expired tokens, provider outages, and malformed model outputs ● You have worked in high trust data environments such as finance, investment, legal, healthcare, or enterprise saas ● You have experience with Supabase, Postgres RLS, Deno, Modal, embeddings, vector search, transcription, GPU workloads, or similar infrastructure ● You have worked with data validation, reconciliation, lineage, observability, or audit systems ● You have experience with AI evals, AI observability, agent testing, or red-teaming AI systems Your day-to-day in this position You will design and ship production-grade systems that combine software engineering, data infrastructure, and AI, including: ● Building secure, scalable full-stack product features ● Designing data models, APIs, integrations, and backend architecture ● Creating reliable data pipelines with strong validation and observability ● Shipping high value high trust AI/LLM-powered features ● Building safe agentic workflows with scoped tools, permissions, logging, evals, and failure handling ● Debugging issues across ingestion, transformation, database, API, UI, and AI context ● Designing systems with security, privacy, auditability, and observability Why work with us? People-first management with minimal bureaucracy A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return Flexible working hours 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays) 10 paid recovery days Full financial and legal support for independent contractors Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers Dedicated HR support Our next steps ✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Intro with the client — ✅ Test Task — ✅ Final client interview— ✅ Offer Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.jd: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact. Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible. What you will do: Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions. Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies. Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers. Requirements Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United Kingdom. There is a preference for candidates to be based in London, with the option to work out of our office. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. Who We Are We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. This role develops and scales large-scale machine learning training systems for multimodal robotics data, enabling the creation of high-performance autonomy models. By optimizing distributed training pipelines, neural network architectures, and data processing workflows, the position improves training efficiency, accelerates model iteration, and maximizes GPU utilization. The role collaborates closely with ML researchers and infrastructure teams, influencing the design, deployment, and performance of end-to-end autonomy models and the large-scale data pipelines that support them. Responsibilities Design and maintain training systems that can process and learn from petabyte-scale multimodal datasets (e.g., video and point cloud data). This includes ensuring data is efficiently loaded, distributed, and processed across large GPU clusters. Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the training pipeline, including data loading, preprocessing, model computation, and inter-node communication, to maximize GPU utilization and reduce training time. Work with the ML team to develop and refine neural network architectures suitable for autonomy tasks, particularly those handling high-dimensional and sequential sensor data. Create and adjust loss functions and training strategies that help the model learn effectively from complex multimodal inputs and improve autonomy performance. Configure, monitor, and maintain large-scale distributed training jobs across multiple machines and GPUs, ensuring stability, fault tolerance, and efficient resource usage. Implement scalable systems to preprocess, transform, and augment large robotics datasets so that they are suitable for model training. Work closely with ML scientists and other engineers to integrate new models, experiments, and training approaches into the production training pipeline. Analyze training metrics, model outputs, and experiment logs to assess model performance and guide improvements in architecture, data usage, or training strategies. Develop tools and workflows that allow teams to run experiments, track results, and iterate quickly on new model ideas or training approaches. Qualifications Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a closely related technical discipline. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience developing, training, and deploying machine learning models in production environments. Hands-on experience training machine learning models across multiple GPUs or compute nodes, including familiarity with distributed training frameworks and large dataset handling. Strong programming skills in Python for implementing machine learning models, data pipelines, and training workflows. Solid knowledge of core concepts such as neural networks, optimization algorithms, loss functions, model evaluation, and training methodologies. What Makes You Stand out Experience identifying and resolving training bottlenecks related to compute utilization, memory usage, and data throughput in machine learning systems. Experience training machine learning models on robotics or autonomous driving datasets involving multimodal sensor inputs such as camera video, LiDAR point clouds, radar, or telemetry data. Experience developing models that combine multiple data modalities (e.g., images, point clouds, and structured sensor data) into a unified learning system. Peer-reviewed publications or significant research contributions in machine learning, robotics, or related areas. * Please note: The listed base salary range applies to candidates based in the US. Compensation may vary depending on location, experience, and role alignment. We are open to qualified candidates working remotely in Canada Canada - ALL: $177k - $215k CAD

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, GenAIUX
jobs.jd: Help shape new Generative AIUX products for AWS customers Our team builds Generative AIUX products that transform the way customers design. We are focused on the future of design driven development and democratizing innovation for all builders. We deliver a shared platform across multiple products, and we work on AI-powered tools that use Design Systems to build interfaces, and accelerate design, development, and validation workflows. The two products you will be working on are Venue and project Arena. GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Building fast matters, and we want engineers who ship. But speed without understanding the problem leads to the wrong solution shipped quickly. You'll partner with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand the real problem first: how work moves across teams, where the real constraint lives, and whether AI is the right intervention. From there, you'll take ownership of the build and deployment, combining strong engineering skills with curiosity about the business systems you're improving.

  • Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions. Ask good questions, surface assumptions, and align with the team on outcomes before jumping to implementation.
  • Track success against defined business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.
  • Contribute to documentation and reusable patterns that help the team scale its impact.

jobs.jd: Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier. We value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive. We are deliberate about the team and culture we are building. We seek engineers who are strong in their own work and care deeply about supporting each other's growth. We are looking for a senior software engineer to make Counterpart Health's existing customer-facing platform agentic. You will build applied AI systems that retrieve relevant information, call tools, and help healthcare users complete meaningful work. You will work with engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals, with ownership across data pipelines, backend services, model behavior, and the user experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will: Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that multiply human efforts. Build and maintain customer-facing agentic AI software, with ownership from data ingestion through to the user interface. Develop retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, pipelines for ingestion, ETL, storage, indexing, retrieval, and context assembly. Build agent workflows that call tools and use application services, with clear permissions, execution limits, and human review where needed. Choose models, storage, retrieval, and orchestration patterns based on product needs and measured results. Protect PHI and tenant boundaries across data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and outputs in a HIPAA-regulated environment. Use customer feedback and failure analysis to improve answers and tool execution. Measure and improve quality, reliability, latency, and cost. Master new tools and technologies to solve concrete user problems while keeping the system simple enough for the team to maintain and operate. Help the team define development practices that support fast iteration and quality, including tests and documentation of key implementations. Work with Product Managers and operational staff to choose useful workflows, define success, and deliver features to customers. You should get in touch if: You have personally owned a production agentic system used by external customers. You can explain your contribution across ingestion, ETL, storage, retrieval, the tool-calling loop, inference, and UI integration. You have used evaluations to improve a live system. Can explain the test data, failure categories, release criteria, and limits of automated or LLM-as-judge scoring. You bring senior software engineering experience and can write, test, debug, and operate the application code behind an AI feature. Python and TypeScript or JavaScript experience are useful, as is comparable experience in another production language. You have experience with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services such as GCP or AWS. You have handled practical LLM limitations, such as context-window limits, unsupported answers, retrieval failures, and incorrect tool calls. Experience with healthcare or another regulated industry is a plus. Experience with tools such as LangGraph, Langfuse, pgvector, or OpenSearch is useful, but we care more about your engineering decisions and production results than a particular framework. Using AI coding assistants, building demos, or shipping internal tools alone does not meet the production AI experience required for this role. You will love this job if: You are curious about how systems work and use pragmatic engineering to solve complicated problems. You test whether an AI approach improves the workflow and use simpler software when it is the better choice. You enjoy a collaborative environment where you help define priorities and own delivery. You bring clarity to ambiguity and change your view when new evidence calls for it. You take responsibility for what reaches customers. You investigate broken behavior, fix the cause, and improve the tests and evaluations that should catch it. You care about what good technology can do for people and want to work with healthcare professionals on tools they can trust. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â Professional Development : We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Reimbursement for office setup expenses Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical e

We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter. About the Role As an AI Engineer in Agent Factory, you’ll design and build the core ML systems behind Workday’s next generation of AI agents. Working within a small, senior, cross-functional pod, you’ll own how models, agent logic, and orchestration layers come together in production—across the full lifecycle from problem framing and data strategy to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You’ll implement and evolve frameworks for LLM-powered agents, including RAG pipelines, workflow orchestration, evaluation, and feedback loops, ensuring solutions are scalable, observable, and enterprise-ready. This role sits at the intersection of ML and platform engineering: partnering closely with software engineers, product managers, and data scientists to integrate agents deeply into the Workday stack. You’ll stay hands-on with emerging techniques in agentic architectures while applying strong engineering judgment to turn them into systems that are reliable, explainable, and built to operate at global scale. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Foundations
jobs.jd:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Assistance Engineering team builds world-class tools for Airbnb's global network of support agents, so guests and hosts get a great experience 24/7, 365 days a year. Airbnb's operational staff must scale with our user base, and we own the entire tech stack behind their success.
Within Assistance Engineering, Assistance Foundations builds the shared platforms that support runs on: case management, the agent workspace, quality and coaching systems, money tooling, data services, agent routing, provisioning and training, and reliability. We are forming a dedicated Machine Learning Engineering group so that intelligence is built once on this foundation and reused across support, rather than rebuilt by each team. You will be one of its founding engineers.

Some of what we are building and shipping:

  • LLM-based quality evaluation that scores support cases against the quality standard, at scale
  • AI coaching that turns quality evidence into coaching plans for team leads
  • Simulation environments that train agents on realistic support scenarios
  • Natural language search and chat tools that help agents and supervisors find answers faster

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the LLM-based and agentic systems behind quality, coaching, case intelligence, and decision support for agents. The work spans prompt design, retrieval, fine-tuning, agent orchestration, dataset engineering, and evaluation. This is a product-building role: you will take systems from first experiment to production and own how they perform for real users.

A Typical Day: 

  • Design, build, and ship LLM-based and agentic systems, from technical design through implementation, experimentation, and deployment.
  • Build offline and online evaluation (human-labeled sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B tests) so that quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Curate and engineer the datasets that prompts, fine-tuned models, and evaluations depend on.
  • Turn one-off models and prompts into shared components that other Foundations teams can adopt.
  • Collaborate with product, design, engineering, data science, and support operations and quality teams to find high-impact problems and quantify results.
  • Participate in design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers.


Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building and shipping applied machine learning, or a PhD in a related field plus 2+ years in industry
  • Recent, hands-on experience building LLM-based systems that shipped to production
  • Expertise in designing and iterating on prompts, fine-tuning, and LLM evaluation
  • Expertise in RAG patterns, memory, tool use, and agent planning
  • Experience integrating LLMs with APIs, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks
  • A solid foundation in machine learning: modeling, evaluation design, experimentation, and A/B testing
  • A track record of shipping AI products used by real users, not only research prototypes or offline models

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams and domains
  • Bachelor's and/or Master's/PhD degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.location: Remote, Israel; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom
jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a senior researcher in GitLab's Threat Research group, you'll turn emerging security threats into protection for GitLab customers. You'll lead your own research projects, taking ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploying it, and analyzing the results. You'll also keep the detection systems you build running in production.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. We build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. This is a full-stack research role: you'll combine an adversarial mindset with the software engineering skills to build and operate the systems behind your work.

What you’ll do

  • Lead your own research projects, from the first idea to the published result.
  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with published findings such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records, responsible disclosures, blog posts, or talks.
  • Experience researching AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and using AI in real work through LLM application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
  • The ability to build systems and assess how to break them, with strong Go or Python skills and practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • An understanding of package ecosystems and supply chain attacks, informed by current security and AI industry trends.
  • The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward while balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, databases or data pipelines at scale, and reverse engineering.

You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

You don't have to match every listed requirement exactly to be considered. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

The Threat Research group at GitLab researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical RCE in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. More on the Security Labs blog.

jobs.jd:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech-a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization, pricing, and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. In this role, you will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several high-impact machine learning domains are actively hiring, and your project and team placement will be aligned based on your individual strengths, interests, and expertise during the interview process. Key domains include:

  • Risk, Fraud & Payments (Growth Alliance): You will own production ML systems that protect HelloFresh from checkout fraud and intelligently recover failed recurring payments (such as Smart Payment Retry) via low-latency scoring on Databricks.
  • Personalization & Conversions (Growth Alliance): You will build real-time decisioning systems, customer win-back models, and scalable GenAI content pipelines that tailor journeys and messaging across visitor and customer funnels.
  • Dynamic Pricing & Customer Value Optimization (Growth Alliance): You will architect and scale the core Pricing Engine to drive pricing optimization and forecasting across 8 brands, 34 markets, and all weekly menus.

Across all domains, you will work on scalable, high-availability production ML systems serving global architectures. Please note that this is an individual contributor role and does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh, we are moving away from a model where engineers simply execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. As a Product Engineer, you will take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

  • Build and operate data products and machine-learning systems, taking them from experimentation through production and owning their real-world performance.
  • Architect and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark on Databricks, Kafka), feature stores, and low-latency serving infrastructure.
  • Improve inference performance, reliability, and compute cost by profiling bottlenecks, right-sizing infrastructure, and maintaining tight latency targets with dependable fallback mechanisms.
  • Establish and raise modern MLOps standards across teams, including CI/CD automation, model registry versioning, infrastructure as code (Terraform), automated validation gates, and drift detection.
  • Design and execute rigorous experimentation frameworks from A/B tests and holdouts to off-policy evaluation-to credibly measure model impact on core business metrics.
  • Build and scale domain-specific applied AI solutions, ranging from real-time scoring and contextual bandits to production GenAI pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to pressure-test models for production readiness, mentor teammates, and leverage AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Cursor) to accelerate engineering delivery.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

  • 5+ years building and operating live ML systems in production, paired with the statistical literacy to design sound experiments and interpret their results.
  • Hands-on experience building product-facing ML solutions directly tied to measurable business metrics (such as conversion, retention, revenue, or risk reduction).
  • Deep command of Python, SQL, and large-scale data processing (PySpark on Databricks), paired with solid software engineering practices (testing, clean code, version control) and familiarity with low-latency serving or backend languages like Go.
  • Hands-on background with cloud environments (AWS), containerization, automated CI/CD, and modern ML or orchestration tooling such as Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, or Terraform.
  • Practical, day-to-day fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) beyond casual experimentation—knowing how to structure context and set clear boundaries on AI-generated work.
  • A quality-first mindset around model evaluation, drift monitoring, and A/B testing pitfalls for ML systems to ensure bad data or outputs never reach customers.
  • A bias to ship ("finishing the last twenty percent"), strong product sense backed by data, and clear communication skills across international, multi-disciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

  • A track record of optimizing data and ML pipelines for performance and cost at scale.
  • Experience with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running production LLM pipelines.
  • Background in churn prediction and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling.
  • Prior experience in high-growth consumer tech or subscription-based businesses.
